newsitem.title: USA: Carson Pirie September same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Carson Pirie September same store sales up.

text.p: Carson Pirie Scott & Co said Thursday its comparable store sales rose 15 percent over the comparable period last year.
Total sales for the five weeks ended October 5, 1996 increased 18.4 percent to $104.0 million, the retailer said in a statement.
Comparable store sales for the year-to-date rose 4.1 percent from a year ago. Total sales for the year-to-date increased 6.1 percent to $638.7 million.

"September sales results were driven by the successful execution of our strategic initiatives and a shift in our promotional calendar," said Stanton Bluestone, chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.

"Exceptional sales growth in our targeted merchandise categories generated a 20 percent comparable store sales gain in the feminine apparel areas and an 18 percent sales gain in the men's area," he said.
In addition, its home furnishings business grew 15 percent led by the textiles and furniture categories.

During September, Carson Pirie Scott said it completed renovations of three additional locations and opened a fourth freestanding furniture location. The company will open one additional department store location and complete the last of its 1996 renovations in the month of October, it said.
Carson Pirie Scott operates 52 department stores and four furniture stores in Illinois, Indiana and Minnesota.
